title: OpenAI countersues Apple for allegedly stealing trade secrets via a staffer who returned to Apple and "coercing and threatening" suppliers that work with both (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: OpenAI countersues Apple for allegedly stealing trade secrets via a staffer who returned to Apple and “coercing and threatening” suppliers that work with both — The ChatGPT maker also accuses the tech giant of ‘coercing and threatening’ suppliers who work with both companies, as legal battle escalates
contentText:
Financial Times :

OpenAI countersues Apple for allegedly stealing trade secrets via a staffer who returned to Apple and “coercing and threatening” suppliers that work with both   —  The ChatGPT maker also accuses the tech giant of ‘coercing and threatening’ suppliers who work with both companies, as legal battle escalates
